campaign_query_lookback_window_in_days.description: The number of days to look back for campaign query data during incremental syncs. Valid range: 2-90. Default: 60.

historical_sync_limit.description: The time range for which historical data should be synced. Default value: `All Time`.

historical_sync_limit_date.description: The start date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which to sync historical data.

is_sailthru_connect_enabled.description: Enable this if you want to sync Sailthru Connect

packing_mode.description: Packing mode for LIST_STATE and USER tables.

s3bucket.description: Name of the bucket configured to receive sailthru connect data.

s3path.description: Copy and use this to configure Sailthru Connect in your sailthru account.

s3role_arn.description: Role ARN of the IAM role created for Fivetran.

use_customer_s3_bucket.description: Enable this if you want to sync Sailthru Connect using your own"  S3 bucket.
